name: Agent editor Context tab: tick documents, save, reload restores checkmark and order
description: Open the seeded API Contract Reviewer, switch to the Context tab, and exercise the per-(agent, repo) document attachment end to end: the discovered documents list (specs/api-layering.md among them) with the '0 of 3 attached' badge, then tick TWO documents in a chosen order (specs/api-layering.md first, then docs/architecture.md) and prove the persisted set survives a full reload — both checkboxes checked and the attached rows numbered 1 and 2 in the tick order. Every tick immediately PUTs the whole ordered set for the selected repo (the picker has no separate save button — whole-set replace, last save wins), so each tick is followed by an innerText assertion of the resulting badge and row order. The ticks are GUARDED wait --fn clicks on the checkbox inside the row matching a path (agent-browser find has no nth-match, and 'first checkbox' would be ambiguous once rows re-render attached-first). MUTATES seeded data (one agent's context attachment set) — needs the hermetic runner's fresh DB, like flow 14; a second run against the same stack would start from the persisted set and the 0-of-3 badge assertion would fail. Tab label and h2 are DOM-cased ('Context', 'Project context' — lowercase c, distinct from the sidebar's 'Project Context'); the badge is CSS-uppercased, so badge assertions use case-insensitive innerText regexes.

steps.label: load the agents page
agents fetch settles
open the seeded API Contract Reviewer
editor route reached with Config active
switch to the Context tab
Context tab active in the URL
documents + attachment fetches settle
the Context tab heading renders (DOM-cased, lowercase c)
the seeded documents are listed
nothing is attached yet (case-insensitive — Badge text is CSS-uppercased)

cmd: () => { const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="checkbox"]')); const cb = cbs.find((c) => { const row = c.closest('div'); return !!row && row.textContent.includes('specs/api-layering.md'); }); if (!cb) return false; if (cb.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') return true; cb.click(); return false; }
steps.label: tick specs/api-layering.md (guarded click on that row's checkbox — saves the whole ordered set immediately)

cmd: () => { const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="checkbox"]')); if (cbs.length === 0) return false; const first = cbs[0]; if (!first || first.getAttribute('aria-checked') !== 'true') return false; const row = first.closest('div'); return !!row && row.textContent.includes('specs/api-layering.md') && /1 of 3 attached/i.test(document.body.innerText); }
steps.label: the row re-rendered attached-first, checked, and the badge counts 1 of 3

cmd: () => { const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="checkbox"]')); const cb = cbs.find((c) => { const row = c.closest('div'); return !!row && row.textContent.includes('docs/architecture.md'); }); if (!cb) return false; if (cb.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true') return true; cb.click(); return false; }
steps.label: tick docs/architecture.md second (it appends after api-layering in the saved order)

cmd: () => { const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="checkbox"]')); const rows = cbs.map((c) => c.closest('div')); const checked = cbs.map((c) => c.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'); return cbs.length === 3 && checked[0] === true && checked[1] === true && !!rows[0] && !!rows[1] && rows[0].textContent.includes('specs/api-layering.md') && rows[1].textContent.includes('docs/architecture.md') && /2 of 3 attached/i.test(document.body.innerText); }
steps.label: both rows sit attached-first in tick order (1. api-layering, 2. architecture), both checked, badge 2 of 3
reload — the attachment set must persist
agents fetch settles again
reopen the seeded agent
editor route reached after reload
switch back to the Context tab
Context tab active in the URL again
documents + attachment fetches settle

cmd: () => { const cbs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role="checkbox"]')); const rows = cbs.map((c) => c.closest('div')); const checked = cbs.map((c) => c.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true'); return cbs.length === 3 && checked[0] === true && checked[1] === true && !!rows[0] && !!rows[1] && rows[0].textContent.includes('specs/api-layering.md') && rows[1].textContent.includes('docs/architecture.md') && /2 of 3 attached/i.test(document.body.innerText); }
steps.label: the reload RESTORED both checkmarks AND the order — api-layering first, architecture second, badge 2 of 3
